harnessDeletionGuards.scope: Capture namespace UIDs at creation, UID-preconditioned delete, no retry after UID conflict, refuse missing bootstrap pins, close port-forward after startup failure

liveE2E.environment: Authorized isolated test namespaces, actual panel/PostgreSQL, independently running TLS development witness, operator and application pod
checks: Foreign existing target is never adopted or changed
Initial full E2E2 view reaches mounted Kubernetes Secret and running application
v1 to v2 changes reload the application with unchanged boot ID and PID
Equal plaintext advances canonical checkpoint without data revision or reload
Witness CAS rejects a same-sequence fork
Corrupted publisher signature fails closed and recovers
Corrupted ciphertext with valid publisher signature fails closed and recovers
Old signed envelope replayed at current hash fails closed and recovers
Stale panel index and old bootstrap floor cannot override fresh witness head
Panel outage retains target, marks data stale and recovers after explicit unseal
Witness outage retains target and recovers after durable journal replay
Operator restart retains identity, checkpoint and application process
RBAC denies Secret list/watch/patch/delete and workload rollout
Missing and replaced state fail closed without target overwrite or implicit bootstrap
Logs and public CR status contain no generated credentials, read keys or demo plaintext

limitations: Development filesystem journal is not WORM and does not prove production restore-domain independence
No stage-5 application rollout is implemented or authorized
No cross-object atomic authorization transaction or instantaneous revocation guarantee
HA fencing, authority rotation and production recovery remain for stage 6
Only the stated Kubernetes version and test storage combination were exercised
No broad Plain/E2E1 operator runtime or migration/UI compatibility claim
A concurrent rollback of all independent trust roots cannot be detected by this protocol
